§3Keep one 107 Singularity Controller in your inventory for this non-consuming check.§r

The 107 is an EV assembler single-shot weapon, directly consuming Steam Entangled Singularities or Critical Steam Entangled Singularities as ammunition. It automatically reloads after a successful shot. Default controls: C changes normal/unstable mode, V changes ammunition, and R reloads; bindings can be changed in settings.

In normal mode, left-click fires. In unstable mode, hold left-click for 5 seconds and release after full charge; collision triggers the final blast immediately. Left-click again while a projectile is flying to begin a gesture that remotely detonates it after 0.5 seconds. Attraction and explosions affect other players and allies, so keep teammates clear.§r
